purpose: Out-of-sample check on symbols never used in any earlier stage: do V2 and B generalise, and does a wider universe help?

selection_rule.candidates: Binance USDT-M perpetuals ending in USDT that have a 1d monthly kline file for 2021-09 (traded before the 2021-10-05 start)
exclude: stablecoin bases: USDC BUSD TUSD FDUSD USDP DAI
require: 1m monthly klines for every month 2021-10..2026-09 plus 1m daily files 2026-10-01..04 on data.binance.vision
an active USDT linear swap on LBank today (ccxt)
selection_rule.rank: sum of quote-asset volume over 2021-09 from the 1d monthly kline file (liquidity at the start, NOT performance)
selection_rule.replacement: a symbol with >0.5% missing minutes is replaced by the next one in the ranking

survivorship_disclosure: Requiring continuous data to 2026 and an LBank listing today drops coins that died; this biases results upward and cannot be avoided for a tradable universe.
data: 1m klines + monthly funding from data.binance.vision, SHA-256 CHECKSUM verified per file; isolated missing minutes forward-filled as flat bars at the previous close and counted; funding unknown Oct 1-4 2026 uses the same adverse 0.01%/8h proxy as before. Same indicators/parity code as high_cagr/prepare.py.

tests.T1_generalisation: NEW10 universe alone (BTC data only used for the B gate): 4B reference vs V2 vs B vs V2+B, 4 slots
tests.T2_universe: ALL15 (old 5 + NEW10): 4B reference vs V2 vs V2+B, at 4 and 6 slots; compared with the old 5-symbol 4B reference

costs_and_periods: R=0.75%, slippage 2 and 5 bps/fill, periods H1/H2/Y2026/full exactly as in predeclared_btc_regime.json
acceptance_T1: a filter generalises if, at BOTH slippage levels: net > 0 in H1,H2,Y2026; full Calmar >= reference + 0.05; full max DD <= reference; full CAGR >= 0.9 x reference; Calmar >= reference in both H1 and H2
acceptance_T2: a wider universe helps if, at both slippage levels, full Calmar >= old-5 reference Calmar + 0.05 with positive net in H1,H2,Y2026
decision: Results only; no bot change without the user's confirmation.
